verdict.rationale: Cake's own docs say founders can "model your raise and see how it affects dilution" and list "round modelling" as a core product feature, so the core of dilution modeling is documented. Its SAFE management and investor communication relate to running SAFE and convertible raises, not to sharing a modeled priced-round scenario. Missing for 10: documented option pool top-up modeling, SAFE/note conversion into a priced round, pro-forma ownership output, sharing a scenario with counsel and investors, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
